coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter chi, dimensionless (plot shows Log10 chi)
notes: First microwave cavity light-shining-through-wall experiment at UWA using two axially stacked cylindrical copper cavities (TE011 mode, ~9.588 GHz). The paper explicitly quotes an upper limit chi = 2.9e-5 at hidden sector photon mass m = 3.788e-5 eV (37.78 ueV), which is the peak sensitivity point. Full exclusion curve shown in Fig. 11 but numerical values not provided in text/table, so only the peak point is extracted. Not a dark-matter haloscope (LSW), so no local DM density assumption. Paper also mentions projected sensitivities (chi ~ 7.2e-9 with 1 W/1 week; chi ~ 1e-12 with Q=1e8 cryogenic cavities) but the reported result is a measured limit. Confidence level not explicitly stated in paper; limit derived from measured microwave leakage floor. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.7, 35)) | Vision: FIG. 11 shows this experiment's limit as a narrow pink V-shaped wedge near log10(m)=-4.4 on a Log10(chi) vs Log10(m/eV) plot spanning [-18,12]x[-15,0].
